Contel serves six fleet sectors: waste collection, highways, construction, cash in transit, transport and logistics, and blue light.
Contel's publicly named UK clients include Biffa, FCC Environment, Canenco (Canterbury City Council), Cardtronics and Stratford-on-Avon District Council.
In September 2025 Contel and Biffa launched Binsight, a connected food-waste bin sensor system, deployed for Stratford-on-Avon District Council.
Canenco, which runs Canterbury City Council's environmental services, deployed Contel's Defend Connected Live 4G DVR vehicle cameras across its fleet in 2022.
